items.title: PCE data ahead; Trump reportedly mulls diesel export ban - what’s moving markets

items.title: Oil bounces as jitters around Mideast supplies persist despite signs of recovery
items.summary: Investing.com - Oil prices turned higher on Wednesday, rebounding after a sharp fall in the previous session, as investors weighed signs of recovering Middle East exports against lingering concerns over ongoing disruptions to shipments through the Strait of Hormuz.
